messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1: prototyping the adapter handshake for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Want a compact manifest that runtime and ops can rely on.

Priya: My suggested manifest keys: version, mode_allowlist, secret_mode, fallback_order, lifecycle_hint, telemetry_tags. Keep it intentionally small.

Dan: Flag: mode_allowlist must be enforceable by policy. If a tenant asks for 'private-only' and factory returns a hosted adapter, that's a compliance bug. We need a pre-check.

Lin: For Private, push to require secret_mode="tenant" or "sidecar" only. No central proxies. Also add an attestation token in the manifest so Private control planes can verify adapter origin.

Mei: Operational: how do we represent quota and SLA differences? Suggest a metric slice field: quota_tier and latency_slo_ms. That way routing can prefer adapters meeting SLO.

Alex: Observability: add adapter_instance_id and manifest_hash to spans. Also require a short human label for dashboards (adapter_label).

Priya: Good. Also proposing a minimum capability set called capability_min which lists: {streaming, kv_cache, quantized_run}. If unavailable, adapter returns capability_min_fail and runtime can route fallback.

Dan: Failure semantics: adapter handshake should be non-blocking. If manifest resolution times out, runtime gets a small static manifest with minimal capabilities + code 'handshake_timeout'. Upstream will then decide degrade or queue.

Lin: For pooled adapters we need lease semantics: lease_ttl_seconds + renew_window. Add renew_jitter_pct to manifest so renewers stagger.

Mei: Also add billing_tag so cost attribution flows back to tenants even when hosted proxies used. Important for audits.

Alex: For rollouts: include variant_stability = one of ["sticky", "ephemeral", "probing"]. Probing is for canary trials where a subset of requests get v2 but no pinning.

Priya: Implementation note: handshake will be a single RPC: POST /handshake {tenant, requested_mode, hint}. Response: manifest + adapter_endpoint or error. Keep response tiny so fastpath stays under 2ms in staging.

Dan: Security check: manifest should include signing_key_id and signature so receivers validate it. For hosted signatures are from our control plane; for private from customer-side signing.

Lin: Also require a small ack loop: adapter periodically posts health + attestation refresh. If attestation fails, orchestrator evicts adapter.

Mei: Suggest we add a lightweight staging harness that exercises handshake failure domains: handshake_timeout, capability_mismatch, signature_invalid, lease_expiry. Catches edge cases before rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy: adapter-handshake-proto v0.1 -> staging canary at 10:08 :rocket:

Priya: Action items: I'll write the manifest schema doc + minimal handshake API in the RFC. Lin: lease jitter impl. Alex: telemetry shims. Dan: failure-domain playbook. Mei: harness tests. Back in a week for a follow-up. :thumbsup:
